sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
The previous corrective RAG example had a retrieval and rewriting loop. A production agentic workflow requires additional authorization, budgets, fallback routing, state persistence and verification.

- The previous corrective RAG example had a retrieval and rewriting loop.
- A production agentic workflow requires additional authorization, budgets, fallback routing, state persistence and verification.
- 33.1 Production state design Security identities and authorization policy should be supplied through trusted runtime context or independently resolved services.
- The LLM must not be allowed to modify the authenticated principal or expand its permissions through graph state.
- 33.2 Deterministic control routing The model may recommend an action, but deterministic application logic enforces the execution policy.
- It can contain confidential business information and must be protected accordingly.

sections.title: 33.2 Deterministic control routing
sections.body:
```python
def route_after_context_check(state):

    if not state["context_authorized"]:
        return "block"

    if state["context_sufficient"]:
        return "generate"

    if state["attempts"] >= state["max_attempts"]:
        return "abstain"

    if state["remaining_token_budget"] <= 0:
        return "abstain"

    return "rewrite"
```

The model may recommend an action, but deterministic application logic enforces the execution policy.

sections.title: 33.3 LangGraph production controls
sections.body:
| Capability | Production consideration |
|--------|--------|
| Conditional edges | Enforce deterministic security and budget rules |
| Checkpointing | Protect persisted conversation and document data |
| Human-in-the-loop | Review high-risk operations and uncertain content |
| Parallel nodes | Prevent uncontrolled fan-out |
| Agent memory | Prevent cross-user or persistent poisoning |
| Tool execution | Validate authorization and arguments |
| State restoration | Revalidate current access permissions |
| Retry policies | Avoid retry amplification |
| Recursion limits | Prevent infinite agent cycles |
| Streaming | Ensure unauthorized text is not emitted before checks |

A checkpoint is not merely technical state. It can contain confidential business information and must be protected accordingly.

points.visualExplanation: This diagram walks through “Capability Production consideration -------- -------- Conditional edges ” one stage at a time.
points.textExplanation: Capability Production consideration -------- -------- Conditional edges Enforce deterministic security and budget rules Checkpointing Protect persisted conversation and document data Human-in-the-loop Review high-risk operations and uncertain content Parallel nodes Prevent uncontrolled fan-out Agent memory Prevent cross-user or persistent poisoning Tool execution Validate authorization and arguments State restoration Revalidate current access permissions Retry policies Avoid retry amplification Recursion limits Prevent infinite agent cycles Streaming Ensure unauthorized text is not emitted before checks
points.body:
| Capability | Production consideration |
|--------|--------|
| Conditional edges | Enforce deterministic security and budget rules |
| Checkpointing | Protect persisted conversation and document data |
| Human-in-the-loop | Review high-risk operations and uncertain content |
| Parallel nodes | Prevent uncontrolled fan-out |
| Agent memory | Prevent cross-user or persistent poisoning |
| Tool execution | Validate authorization and arguments |
| State restoration | Revalidate current access permissions |
| Retry policies | Avoid retry amplification |
| Recursion limits | Prevent infinite agent cycles |
| Streaming | Ensure unauthorized text is not emitted before checks |
